title: addr_resolve: Allow for port to be configured
description:
If nameservers use a different default port than 53, Wireshark
is not able to resolve, as it always assumes the default port.

This allows to configure both tcp/udp ports for name resolutions,
with the udp port being asked first and tcp only used for fallback

Implements #18214

https://c-ares.org/ares_set_servers_ports.html
**ares_set_servers_ports** was added in c-ares 1.11.0.

This changes breaks with older C-Ares, as minimum required is 1.5.0

note: RHEL7 has c-ares 1.10.0

As much as I would like to support that version, but it is 13 years old. SLES 12 does not even include c-ares and other distros have also issues. I would rather update the minimum version to a somewhat newer, more secure version (aka 1.14 or 1.15). There where some CVEs fixed in those versions as well. 

On -dev we already demand Qt to be at 5.12 with some lenience for 5.10 and 5.11 due to Debian buster. RHEL 7  would therefore not build anymore anyway for Qt, as it only has 5.9. The next -dev is a major release, therefore we discussed it at #SFUS and found that we should break some barriers to make our life a little bit easier. 3.6 will stay on the older versions and will be supported throughout the lifetime of those distros anyway (we maybe need to extend our support for it a little).
